sources.quote: Kepler-7 is a star located in the constellation Lyra in the field of view of the Kepler Mission, a NASA operation in search of Earth-like planets.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Esteves et al. 2015.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-7"
sources.quote: It is home to the fourth of the first five planets that Kepler discovered; this planet, a Jupiter-size gas giant named Kepler-7b, is as light as styrofoam.
